dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the upper dorsal-lateral region show sharp pixel-intensity gradients transitioning from dark-gray perimeters to light-gray interiors with irregular, jagged perimeters.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, high-luminance pixel clusters concentrated along the lower flank and lower neck region, showing solid luminance without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three primary macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal section form a shallow obtuse triangle oriented along the animal's longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A localized area of high-intensity pixels is present around the ocular region, contrasting sharply with the lower-intensity pixels of the rostrum and snout.
